summary: From a blank file you add a database health check, a one-off ingest service, and a start order with service_healthy and service_completed_successfully, then the health check of the AI service in the Dockerfile. docker compose config catches a misspelt condition and an unknown service before anything starts. The lesson says plainly that no container was started.
goal: M13: health checks and a start order from a blank file.

items.text: Draw the start order on paper before writing a line
Write the database health check with pg_isready and run docker compose config -q
Write the one-off ingest service that waits for a healthy database
Make the AI service wait for the ingest to complete with success and add the HEALTHCHECK
Run docker compose up -d --build and watch the states in docker compose ps
Misspell a condition and point depends_on at a missing service, and read both errors
Play the Start Order game to the end and see your score
